learning_plan.execution_strategy_summary: This isn't just a study plan; it's your personalized launchpad into a full-stack career. We're leveraging your strong foundation in multiple languages, existing familiarity with .NET and React, and your C# and JavaScript preferences to rapidly build production-ready skills. By constantly building and deploying a progressively complex 'Task Management' application, and culminating in a substantial capstone, you'll bridge academic knowledge with critical industry demands, making you an undeniable candidate for a fast job.

monthly_plan.theme: Solidifying Foundations & Diving Deep into C#
weekly_micro_goals: Week 1: You'll master Git and GitHub/Azure Repos, moving beyond basics to collaborative workflows and resolving conflicts. This isn't just about committing code; it's about confidently managing team projects.

Week 2: We're kicking off C# Language Mastery, focusing on advanced features like LINQ and async/await, immediately applying modern OOP principles (SOLID). This builds directly on your existing C# familiarity, ensuring you write professional-grade code from day one.

Week 3: Begin your journey into Advanced Data Structures & Algorithms. We'll start with a review of key structures and Big O notation, tackling your first set of LeetCode problems to shift from theory to optimized problem-solving. This is crucial for interview performance.

Week 4: Initiate Relational Database Mastery. You'll dive into advanced SQL, practicing schema design, complex joins, and window functions, preparing you to build performant databases. This enhances your prior database exposure by focusing on industry-standard practices.
technical_skills_to_master: Confidently use Git & GitHub for team collaboration, including advanced branching and merge conflict resolution.
Write clean, performant C# code using advanced features (LINQ, async/await) and applying SOLID principles.
Analyze and solve foundational DSA problems, articulating time/space complexity in C#.
Design normalized database schemas and write complex SQL queries.
interview_prep_goals: Solve 10-15 LeetCode 'Easy' problems, focusing on common patterns.
Clearly articulate OOP principles (SOLID) and their application in C#.
Practice explaining your Git workflow.

critical_guidelines: **The 70/30 Rule is Sacred:** For every hour of passive learning (reading, watching tutorials), you MUST dedicate at least two hours to active practice and project building. This means 30% theory, 70% doing. This is how skills are forged, not just learned.

**Time-Box Your Struggles:** Getting stuck is normal, but don't let it derail you. If you've spent more than 30-60 minutes on a single bug or concept, step away, take a break, or actively seek help (Stack Overflow, Discord, mentor). Your time is too valuable to get bogged down.

**No Beginner Projects:** We're beyond 'To-Do Lists' and 'Calculators.' Every project, from day one, must be geared towards solving a 'real' problem, showcasing end-to-end execution, and eventually hosted in the cloud with a professional README. Quality over quantity.

**Build Incrementally & Continuously:** Projects aren't just for the end. Your 'Task Management' application is your living canvas, growing in complexity each month. Embrace iterative development and deploy early and often. This is how real software is built.

**Prioritize Interview Prep Daily:** DSA and System Design aren't optional side quests; they're integrated into your weekly rhythm. Consistency here will pay dividends in your 'fast job' search. Apply concepts from your projects directly to interview questions.
learning_plan.final_readiness_summary: Congratulations! After 12 months, you won't just be a recent CSE graduate; you'll be a production-ready, full-stack software engineer. Your existing language versatility will be supercharged by deep expertise in C#/.NET and React/TypeScript. Your portfolio, featuring a fully deployed, secure, and performant Capstone Project, will be an irrefutable testament to your ability to deliver end-to-end solutions, from database to UI, deployed on Azure with robust CI/CD. Recruiters will see a highly capable, adaptable engineer who understands the full development lifecycle, ready to make an immediate impact.
